conviction_note: Near-zero net: the Kanto supermarket peers that reported the same Jun-Aug quarter this week showed sharp margin compression and two cut their plans (a negative for an Eco's Q2 that has no monthly series to pre-release it), but Eco's Q1 ran ahead of its own progress history with a plan already guiding OP -4%, the stock has already fallen 5.1% in five sessions alongside those peers, and its last two H1 prints were bought; findings sum to -0.10 and the scaled number (p_up 47 x abs 2.8) to -0.17, the same sign and size.
bar: Company full-year plan only (OP 5,500m / ordinary 5,500m / revenue 138,000m, set 2026-04-14 and held 2026-07-14; no H1 forecast is published, no IFIS consensus exists: kabuyoho shows コンセンサス予想 '--'). The implied H1 bar is ~51-53% of FY ordinary (the company's own H1 share: 49.1% FY24.02, 52.8% FY25.02, 52.4% FY26.02) = ~2,860m ordinary, so Q2 needs ~1,310m vs 1,513m a year ago. My estimate ~2,800m H1 ordinary, -2% vs that implied bar. Sources: https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=7520 , https://kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=7520 . The bar is company-sourced but no street number exists, so sizes are capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short-selling register: 0.0% disclosed (no position >=0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, from the sealed baseline). Margin ratio 信用倍率 74.0 (scraped, baseline): margin longs heavily crowded, which is the one setup where a visible miss still has sellers. No option skew exists. Tape: -5.03% 20d, -5.07% 5d, with -3.9% on 2026-10-08 (the day Life Corp reported) and the company's own buyback finishing 2026-10-07. priced_lean_pct -0.68 (margin overhang -0.94, run-up +0.25).

findings.finding: The Feb-FY supermarket peers that reported the same Mar-Aug half this week show Jun-Aug margin compression on price competition, falling customer counts and Middle-East-driven energy/packaging costs: Belc (Saitama, overlapping Eco's territory) Q2 ordinary -28.1% with OP margin 4.7%->3.3% and FY ordinary cut to 15.6bn from 18.2-20.0bn; USMH cut FY OP to 1.0bn from 10.0bn; Life Q2 ordinary -5.2%; Heiwado H1 ordinary -18%. Eco's own Q1 短信 already flagged 節約志向 strengthening and launched a price campaign (プラセレ), so its Q2 margin is likely down and a FY trim at this print is possible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Eco's last plan change: FY26.02 cut 3% on 2026-04-07, followed by -4.25% at the 2026-04-14 print that guided OP -4% (baseline history, estimated dates). Peers this week: Life -3.1% on a held plan, Belc -5.2% and USMH -6.4% on cuts (Yahoo chart 2026-10-08/09/13).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: Eco's fell 3.9% on 2026-10-08 and is -5.1% over five sessions while TOPIX ETF 1306 was flat, which is what a market already reading the peers through looks like. What is not priced is Eco's own Q2 number: it publishes no 月次 (its IR page carries none), so unlike the peers' monthly-visible quarters there is no public series for its Jun-Aug margin, and no street estimate to have been cut. If the market had fully priced a cut, the stock would have fallen nearer Belc's/USMH's -5 to -6% on their actual cut days rather than drifting.
findings.independence: USMH revision https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20261009/140120261008548093.pdf and Life H1 https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8194&b=k202610080001 are separate companies' documents pointing the same way; Eco's own Q1 短信 https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260710591477.pdf describes the same consumer backdrop. All one sector theme, so counted once.

findings.finding: Eco's plan has cushion: Q1 ordinary 1,553m was 28.2% of the 5,500m FY plan against a 5-year average Q1 progress of 24.3% and 26.9% last year, Q1 OP was flat YoY (-0.2%) while Belc/USMH/Life Q1 fell, and the plan already budgets OP -4% / ordinary -6.6%; Q2 ordinary can fall ~13% YoY and still leave H1 at the company's usual ~52% of FY, so a held plan (relief) is at least as likely as a cut.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Eco's last two H1 prints were bought: 2024-10-15 (H1 ordinary +14%) +6.15%, 2025-10-14 (H1 ordinary -7%, plan held, 優待 change) +2.58%; Q1 2026-07-14 (flat, plan held) +2.57% (baseline history, dates estimated but matching the TDnet 15:00 release dates).
findings.why_not_priced: The stock has been sold with the sector this week as if Eco's carried the peers' Q2; a held plan from a company whose Q1 outran its own progress history would be relief (悪材料出尽くし). If the market were pricing Eco's own cushion it would not have tracked Life's down day almost one for one.
findings.independence: Q1 短信 https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260710591477.pdf (plan held, Q1 numbers) and kabutan quarterly table https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=7520 (prior-year H1 shares). Same company documents, counted once.

findings.finding: The 2026-04-14 buyback (up to 300,000 shares / 900m yen, to 2027-04-20) hit its share cap on 2026-10-07, six months early and 179m yen unspent, after buying 15,000 shares on 1-7 Oct (~20% of daily volume); the steady buyer is gone from the tape, and a new authorisation at H1 is possible but has no precedent (the last two H1s added none).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The buyback was announced with the FY print 2026-04-14, which fell -4.25% alongside a -4% OP guide; the 2025-10-14 H1 carried a 優待 change and rose +2.58%. No H1 buyback precedent.
findings.why_not_priced: The exit of the buyer already showed (the 2026-10-08 -3.9% came the day after the programme ended), so that half is priced; a re-authorisation with the results is not in the price because nothing signals it. Expected value is small: maybe one chance in five of a ~+3% item.
findings.independence: none (cash fell to 10.15bn and FY26 FCF was 264m with new long-term borrowing in Q1, which argues against a large new programme; kabutan finance page https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=7520)

findings.finding: Eco's completed the purchase of 100% of Fresco Kanto (6 supermarkets in Tokyo/Kanagawa, renamed ベンガベンガ) on 2026-10-01, after the half closed; the company states the FY impact is minor.
findings.why_not_priced: Already public 12 days and declared immaterial by the company; sized at 0.

baseline_tension: The peer negative agrees with the sealed lean (-0.68, crowded margin long) and with the -5% run-in, so it is largely held already; the strongest positive the release could carry is a held FY plan from a company whose Q1 ran ahead of its own history (looked for, filed +0.4) or a new buyback (looked for, no precedent, filed +0.3), and the name's last two H1 prints were bought.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on public series): the peer-read negative rests on prints the market already has and the stock already fell with them; p_up moved 45 -> 47. Finding sizes unchanged, since the proxy discount was already taken in the draft.
Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): the strongest positives (held plan, buyback) were looked for and filed; no further change.
